top_signals.title: Fed’s Collins Says ‘Steady, Gradual’ Rate Hikes Appropriate
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said a gradual path for interest-rate hikes will be appropriate to lower inflation, as the labor market gains solid footing without adding to price pressures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
top_signals.summary: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
